metadata.question: Was the primary direction of the Eyjafjallajökull volcanic plume toward the north rather than the south on May 10, 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to visualize the Eyjafjallajökull volcanic plume on May 10, 2010 - Location: Iceland, Eyjafjallajökull volcano (approximately 63.63°N, 19.62°W) - Use satellite imagery that can detect volcanic plumes (aerosols/ash) - Sentinel-5P for aerosol data or MODIS Terra/Aqua for aerosol optical depth - Since this is 2010, Sentinel-5P won't work (launched 2017). Use MODIS. - MODIS Aerosol product or True Color imagery to see the plume direction 2. Masking strategy: - We want to see the volcanic plume, so we should NOT mask clouds/aerosols - Instead, look for high aerosol optical depth or visible ash in imagery - Compare aerosol concentrations or visible plume to the north vs south of the volcano 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If no images available for May 10, 2010 → C1 - If images exist but cannot detect plume direction → C2/C3 - If plume clearly extends more to the north → A (Yes) - If plume extends more to the south → B (No) - Use aerosol optical depth to measure plume density in northern vs southern regions ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions volcano_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 63.63]) # Eyjafjallajökull date = '2010-05-10' # Define regions: north and south of the volcano # North region (0-200km north) north_box = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-21.0, 63.63, -18.0, 65.5]) # South region (0-200km south) south_box = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-21.0, 61.5, -18.0, 63.63]) # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_L2') \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(volcano_point) modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD04_L2') \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(volcano_point) terra_size = modis_terra.size().getInfo() aqua_size = modis_aqua.size().getInfo() print(f"MODIS Terra images: {terra_size}") print(f"MODIS Aqua images: {aqua_size}") if terra_size == 0 and aqua_size == 0: print("No MODIS data available for May 10, 2010") print("C1") else: # Use whichever has data, prefer Terra collection = modis_terra if terra_size > 0 else modis_aqua # Get AOD (Aerosol Optical Depth) - band: Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean aod_image = collection.select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').mean() # 3. Calculate mean AOD in north and south regions north_stats = aod_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=north_box, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) south_stats = aod_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=south_box, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) # Also get pixel counts north_count = aod_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=north_box, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo() south_count = aod_image.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=south_box, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo() north_aod = north_stats.get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo() south_aod = south_stats.get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo() print(f"North region - AOD: {north_aod}, Pixels: {north_count}") print(f"South region - AOD: {south_aod}, Pixels: {south_count}") # 4. Validation & Final Answer if north_count == 0 and south_count == 0: print("No valid pixels in either region") print("C2") elif north_aod is None or south_aod is None: print("Failed to calculate AOD values") print("C3") elif north_aod > south_aod: print("Higher aerosol concentration to the north - plume directed northward") print("A") else: print("Higher aerosol concentration to the south - plume directed southward") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
volcano_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 63.63])  # Eyjafjallajökull
date = '2010-05-10'

# Define regions: north and south of the volcano
# North region (0-200km north)
north_box = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-21.0, 63.63, -18.0, 65.5])
# South region (0-200km south)
south_box = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-21.0, 61.5, -18.0, 63.63])

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth
modis_terra = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD04_L2') \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(volcano_point)

modis_aqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD04_L2') \
    .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(volcano_point)

terra_size = modis_terra.size().getInfo()
aqua_size = modis_aqua.size().getInfo()

print(f"MODIS Terra images: {terra_size}")
print(f"MODIS Aqua images: {aqua_size}")

if terra_size == 0 and aqua_size == 0:
    print("No MODIS data available for May 10, 2010")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Use whichever has data, prefer Terra
    collection = modis_terra if terra_size > 0 else modis_aqua
    
    # Get AOD (Aerosol Optical Depth) - band: Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean
    aod_image = collection.select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').mean()
    
    # 3. Calculate mean AOD in north and south regions
    north_stats = aod_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=north_box,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    south_stats = aod_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=south_box,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    # Also get pixel counts
    north_count = aod_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=north_box,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    south_count = aod_image.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=south_box,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    north_aod = north_stats.get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    south_aod = south_stats.get('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean').getInfo()
    
    print(f"North region - AOD: {north_aod}, Pixels: {north_count}")
    print(f"South region - AOD: {south_aod}, Pixels: {south_count}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if north_count == 0 and south_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in either region")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif north_aod is None or south_aod is None:
        print("Failed to calculate AOD values")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif north_aod > south_aod:
        print("Higher aerosol concentration to the north - plume directed northward")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("Higher aerosol concentration to the south - plume directed southward")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
